headline: Frontline Flares at Fishermans Row, Dead Lands
war_summary: Since the 0900 edition the map has tightened to a handful of hot sectors. Fishermans Row, previously quiet, has erupted with six base changes in the last two hours and thirty‑four in the past day, making it the most active hex on the front. Dead Lands remains the bloodiest theatre, logging seven flips in the last six hours and thirteen over twenty‑four, with combined casualty rates above 2,700 per hour. Godcrofts has added two captures in the latest window, while Linn Mercy, though still heavy in losses, has recorded no fresh ownership changes in the past two hours. Lykos Isle continues to bleed heavily and produced two captures in the last six hours. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each saw a handful of flips over the day but none recently. Meanwhile Weathered Expanse and Callahans Passage show sharply rising attrition on both sides without territorial movement. Overall, base turnover is now concentrated in Fishermans Row, Dead Lands, and Godcrofts, while the broader line bleeds manpower in entrenched, static fights.
